releaseNotes.zh-CN:
MyCodex 8.2.0 更新日志

• 新增 Hooks 管理（设置 › 扩展 › Hooks 管理）：可查看当前目标的 hooks，信任、撤销信任、启用或禁用；支持打开来源文件编辑，新建和删除 hook 定义。连接、新建或切换会话时，如有未审阅或已修改的 hooks，会弹框提示审阅；后台时只播放提示音和语音，回到前台再弹框。Hook 的运行结果会显示在活动时间线中，可通过“显示 Hook 消息”开关关闭。中文界面显示中文事件名，并保留官方名称便于对照。
• 修复 Windows 用户名或目录含中文时的问题：系统 Codex 安装在中文路径下时无法识别，以及电脑控制在中文路径下通信乱码导致操作失败。查找系统 Codex 时不再搜索启动目录，避免误用其中的同名程序。感谢 1heibaimiao 的贡献。
• 认证后端升级至 0.4.2，修复长会话自动压缩上下文后，部分第三方模型请求返回 400“message content cannot be empty”而无法继续的问题。感谢 zhuqiang1248 的反馈。
• 改进认证中心：首次使用时，如果 Codex 配置目录尚不存在，会自动创建，不再无法启动；认证组件安装或升级后，后台未能启动时，下次启动 MyCodex 会自动完成恢复。Linux 目标因缺少系统运行库而无法启动认证后台时，会给出所需库和安装命令。感谢 wangru2025 的贡献。
• 修复最小化后用 Alt+Tab 切回时，主窗口偶尔仍停在最小化状态、键盘操作全部无响应的问题；现在会自动还原窗口并把焦点放回原来的位置。
• 启动时在后台静默准备浏览器控制，不再显示等待框；准备失败时只在状态栏提示。电脑控制与浏览器组件更新至官方 26.1106.6628.0。
releaseNotes.en-US:
MyCodex 8.2.0 Release Notes

• Added Hooks Management (Settings › Extensions › Hooks Management). View the hooks for the current target, trust or revoke trust, and enable or disable them; open a hook's source file to edit it, and create or delete hook definitions. When you connect, or create or switch conversations, MyCodex asks you to review hooks that are new or have changed. In the background it only plays a sound and speaks, and shows the dialog when you return. Hook runs appear in the activity timeline and can be hidden with the Show hook messages switch. The Chinese interface shows translated event names alongside the official names.
• Fixed issues when the Windows user name or folders contain Chinese characters: a system Codex installed in such a path was not recognized, and Computer Use failed because messages were garbled. System Codex lookup no longer searches the launch folder, so a program with the same name there is not picked up by mistake. Thanks to 1heibaimiao for the contribution.
• Updated the authentication backend to 0.4.2. Fixed requests to some third-party models failing with HTTP 400 "message content cannot be empty" after a long conversation was automatically compacted. Thanks to zhuqiang1248 for the report.
• Improved Authentication Center. If the Codex configuration folder does not exist yet on first use, it is now created automatically instead of preventing startup. If the backend fails to start after the authentication component is installed or updated, MyCodex completes the recovery the next time it starts. When the authentication backend cannot start on a Linux target because system libraries are missing, MyCodex now lists the required libraries and the command to install them. Thanks to wangru2025 for the contribution.
• Fixed the main window sometimes staying minimized after switching back with Alt+Tab, leaving the keyboard unresponsive. MyCodex now restores the window and returns focus to where it was.
• Browser control is now prepared silently in the background at startup instead of showing a wait dialog; failures are reported only in the status bar. Updated the Computer Use and browser components to official version 26.1106.6628.0.
